stories.title: Amen Thompson Signs 5-Year, $208M Extension with Houston Rockets

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Amen Thompson just got PAID. 🚀

The Houston Rockets locked up their cornerstone: 5 years, $208M.

Last season: 18.3 ppg | 7.8 reb | 5.3 ast | Led ALL of the NBA in minutes (2,943).

He's 22. This is just the beginning. #Rockets #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
$208 million for Amen Thompson.

The Rockets aren't rebuilding — they're building a dynasty. Thompson locked in through 2031 and he hasn't even scratched the surface yet.

Houston's future is BRIGHT. #Rockets #NBA

stories.title: LeBron James Signs 2-Year, $8M Deal with Philadelphia 76ers — "Last Decision"

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
LeBron James called it his "last decision."

He chose the Philadelphia 76ers. 2 years, $8M. Player option Year 2.

At 41, LeBron teams up with Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Maxey and Edgecombe.

One last championship run. #Sixers #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
The Philadelphia 76ers now have LeBron James, Joel Embiid and Jaylen Brown on the same roster.

Let that sink in.

The East just got a whole lot more complicated. Defending champs Knicks on notice. #Sixers #NBA

stories.title: DeAndre Ayton Traded to Washington Wizards

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
The Lakers have traded DeAndre Ayton to the Washington Wizards for Jaden Hardy and two second-round picks.

LA already has Walker Kessler at center. Now they add youth and draft capital. Roster reshaping continues. #Lakers #NBA

The Raptors rebuild is about to begin. #Raptors #NBA
